public_rationale: Paid business adoption and realized revenue are material counterevidence to a literal absence of demand. In context, however, Zitron acknowledges popularity and disputes whether demand can support the investment. The retrieved evidence does not establish that broader economic outcome. Continuing cash burn also cannot prove that sustainable demand will never arrive. No decisive event closes the unlimited forecast under the stated rule.
limitations: The outcome depends on the contextual meaning of demand; a simple paying-customer reading would face direct counterevidence.
Ramp measures businesses on its platform, not the whole economy.
The financial figures are attributed reporting on one private company, not audited sector accounts.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: Demand for generative AI is not there and will never arrive.

statement.excerpt: I am telling you, as I have been telling you for years, again and again and again, that the demand is not there for generative AI, and the demand is never, ever arriving.

from_speaker: the demand is not there for generative AI
the demand is never, ever arriving
our_interpretation: Read demand in the surrounding investment argument as sustained commercial demand capable of supporting generative-AI provision and its associated infrastructure.
The context explicitly acknowledges ChatGPT’s popularity, so the claim should not be reduced to an assertion that no users or paying customers exist.
Supporting the buildout means customer receipts can sustain service costs and capital consumption at material commercial scale; it does not require every speculative investment to succeed.
The speaker supplies no numerical demand threshold, required return or deadline. These economic distinctions are evaluator interpretations.
criteria.support_condition: A finite period of weak economics cannot establish never. Support would require a decisive permanent cessation of the relevant commercial activity with the predicted absence of sustainable demand.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Dated evidence establishes sustained customer-funded generative-AI activity at material scale, with receipts sufficient to support service provision and associated infrastructure over its useful life.
